resources.string: Check the title or correction reason
Enter a valid date and time zone.
This is the observation time in the indicated time zone. The recorded time is kept separately. A missing or ambiguous local time during a clock change must be corrected.

Choose what the tracked quantity represents. Operations use exactly the same unit and convention. Apparent volume, solid wood, tonnes, steres and pieces are neither combined nor automatically converted.

Explicitly declare a positive or zero physical starting quantity. A geometric measurement does not create stock. Date, unit and convention are required; pieces must be whole numbers. This quantity is not a payable amount.

Enter the strictly positive quantity actually removed. The displayed stock comes from recorded operations at the entered date and excludes this draft. Saving also checks the history: no removal may make the balance negative for the same unit and convention.

Enter the observed remainder independently of the theoretical stock. A control records an observation; it does not change or reset stock. A comparison without an available reference remains unknown. Pieces must be whole numbers.

Wood present and Pile bottom require a positive quantity. Zero observed means no wood remains: the quantity is zero after that explicit choice. Not quantified records an observation without a quantity; it never means zero.
